$comment: Baseline of the V1 pilot (design section 6.4): T1 = the model alone, without search; T2 = one standard VP run on the idea, then a recommendation by the same model. Each test of 'tests' follows the item schema of schemas/tests.json (checked by tools/export_judge.py), so that tools/export_judge.py --baseline FILE gives a judge.json with the same keys as a Frontier directory, for the paired comparison. produced_by and recommendation never reach the judges.

produced_by.description: how the baseline was produced (no model name needed)

vp_run.description: path of the VP run (required for T2)
